errors.text_span: след което остава около 9% приблизително до 2022
errors.evidence: The description for the dark blue line (ЦКБ) incorrectly states that after 2014 it remains at about 9% until 2022. The chart shows that the line rises from its low of ~9% in 2014 to about 10% by 2018 and then stays at that level until 2022.
The description for the grey line (Общинска банка) states its value was around 6.5-7% in 2016-2017. However, the chart shows the line is only slightly above 6% during this period, not reaching 6.5%.
The description for the yellow line (Интернешънъл Асет Банк) states it reached about 12% in 2009. The chart shows a clear peak at approximately 13% in that year.
